tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i bka' yig bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zag pa med dbyings nam mkha'i khams// thugs rje'i sprin gyis khyab mdzad de// dri med chos kyi char 'bebs pa// sangs rgyas klu dbang la phyag 'tshal// rgyal bu khyod kyis sangs rgyas la// srid pa snga mar tshogs rab bsags// de yi dbang gis sku tshe 'dir// phun tshogs brnyes khyod rgyal gyur cig /sngon yang sangs rgyas bstan la khyod// dad pa'i bag chags cher sad pas// 'dir yang mi phyed dad pa'i thugs// dag pa khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /khyod kyis bde 'gro'i dpal 'byor mchog /brnyes pa snga ma'i 'bras bu lags// slar yang dam pa'i chos kyis thugs// grol gyur khyod ni rgyal gyur cig /khyod kyis rgyal srid rgyal po yi// khrims bzhin bskyangs pa ngo mtshar mod// de dag bas kyang dam chos kyis// bdag gzhan phan bgyid ngo mtshar lags// slar yang khyod kyi ngo mtshar gyi// mdzad spyod phyogs su rgyas pa dang*// sku tshe'ang kun nas brtan bya'i phyir// shis pa de dag brjod pa lags// de ltar bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa sngon du brjod nas/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa'i snyan du chos kyi rje sa skya paṇḍi ta chen po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa chos smra ba 'phags pas zhu ba'i tshig yi ger bkod nas phyag tu phul ba/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' sku khams bzang zhing phrin las rgya che bar bzhugs pa thos pas yid dga'/ nged yon mchod thams cad kyang bde bar mchis/ khyed kyis thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs nas spyir rgyal khams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan par dgongs pa'i mdzad pa rgya chen po dang*/ bye brag tu bdag cag lta bu'i dman pa'ang thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi khongs su chud par mdzad nas/ gsung snyan po bdud rtsi'i rgyun lta bu/

dngos po rnam par dag pa'i zang zing dang bcas pa gnang ba thugs dgongs dag pa'i stobs kyis bdag gi lag tu phyin pas yid dga' ba ngang gis 'phel bar gyur/ sngar yang ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du nged kyi phyogs nas rang don gtso bor ma byas par/ bklag dang nus pa yod tshad kyi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sems can spyi la gang phan bgyis pa lags/ 'on kyang snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gyur ba dang*/ sems can spyi mthun gyi las gang zag re res bzlog dka' bar gda'/ da dung yang zhal ta bzhin du nus tshad kyis bsgrub pa lags/ khyod kyis kyang thugs la cher gdags par zhu/ mjal bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa shin tu che bar mchis pas/ ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du myur du mjal ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ slar yang zhu ba'i tshig tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ khyod kyi dpal 'byor phun tshogs pa// lhun grub phyir na 'bad ci 'tshal// 'dir ni sku tshe brtan phyir dang*// mthar thug byang chub chen po'i phyir// dgongs pa dag pa khyod kyi thugs// g.yel ba med par dgongs 'tshal lo// bzhes pa'i tshod kyang rig pa dang*// gshegs dang bzhugs gnas brtag pa dang*// nyon mongs dbang du mi 'gyur ba// 'di gsum bde bar gnas pa'i rgyu// gzhan gyi srog la byams pa dang*// lus sems dben par gnas pa dang*// dge dang rnal 'byor rab brtson pa// 'di gsum sku tshe brtan pa'i rgyu// sdig pa'i las las ldog pa dang*// dge la spro bas bsgrub pa dang*// stong nyid snying rjes sems 'dul ba// 'di gsum byang chub chen po'i rgyu// sum tshan gsum du spel ba yi// chos tshul rnam pa dgu po 'di// rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la// 'phags pa'i 'dab nor chen po lags// rab tu gnas pa legs par byas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa gcig thugs dam du 'bul// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
